title: Dizon tasks new DOTr officials with fast-tracking transport reforms

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon tasked his newly appointed officials with accelerating reforms across the transport sector within the remaining 18 months of the Marcos administration. “There are many things that need to be done, and our time is very limited,” Dizon said during a press conference on Wednesday, Nov. 25. Joining Dizon at the press conference were former Land Transportation Office (LTO) chief Markus Lacanilao, now head of the Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA); new LTO chief Noreen Bernadette San Luis; and Jorjette Aquino, the new Philippine National Railways general manager.
